eyebrow: Bug 1: accumulating the tensor, not the value
code:
running_loss = 0.0
for x, y in train_loader:
    optimizer.zero_grad()
    loss = loss_fn(model(x), y)
    loss.backward()
    optimizer.step()
    running_loss += loss.item()
    # running_loss += loss  <- keeps the graph alive
caption: No crash -- just memory quietly growing all epoch.
